result.title: Restrained Diffusion Bridges: Targeted Denoiser Training and Refinement
result.summary: Diffusion models are often inaccurate in critical, data-sparse regions of the target distribution. Sampling from restrained distributions, biased distributions used in classical enhanced sampling to concentrate data near chosen configurations, can control where training data are collected but biases the learned distribution. We establish that this bias cancels exactly when forward noising from restrained data is conditioned on the restrained configuration at an appropriately chosen intermediate time. This allows a pretrained model fine-tuned on restrained data to achieve high accuracy in any chosen region of the target distribution, regardless of its probability, using standard denoising or flow matching objectives without importance weights. When no target data are available, Gibbs sampling enables inference from a model trained exclusively on restrained data.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何在目标分布的低概率、数据稀疏区域准确建模：证明当从受约束数据前向加噪时，在合适的中间时刻以该受约束配置为条件，采样偏置可精确抵消，从而用标准去噪或 flow matching 目标微调预训练模型即可在任意指定区域获得高精度，无需重要性权重；无目标数据时借 Gibbs sampling 推断。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「只在指定区域收集数据、再用中间时刻条件化消偏」的训练机制，可能可供核查能否用于让 latent 推理状态在稀有视觉证据区域获得准确监督，而不引入重要性加权。
